hooks.command: printf '%s\n' "[grok] adapter SessionEnd → control layer (live-board + cleanup-session report + daemon session.end + hotfix + temp-scripts)"

FLEET="${REVEALFLEET_ROOT:-$HOME/revealfleet}"; if [ ! -d "$FLEET/revealui" ] && [ ! -f "$FLEET/.jv/scripts/session-start-fleet.js" ]; then FLEET="$HOME/revealfleet"; fi; node "$FLEET/.jv/scripts/session-end-fleet.js" || true

FLEET="${REVEALFLEET_ROOT:-$HOME/revealfleet}"; if [ ! -d "$FLEET/revealui" ] && [ ! -f "$FLEET/.jv/scripts/session-start-fleet.js" ]; then FLEET="$HOME/revealfleet"; fi; node "$FLEET/revealui/packages/harnesses/dist/cli.js" session end 2>/dev/null || revealui-harnesses session end 2>/dev/null || true

FLEET="${REVEALFLEET_ROOT:-$HOME/revealfleet}"; if [ ! -d "$FLEET/revealui" ] && [ ! -f "$FLEET/.jv/scripts/session-start-fleet.js" ]; then FLEET="$HOME/revealfleet"; fi; node "$FLEET/revealui/packages/harnesses/dist/cli.js" hotfix check 2>/dev/null || revealui-harnesses hotfix check 2>/dev/null || true

FLEET="${REVEALFLEET_ROOT:-$HOME/revealfleet}"; if [ ! -d "$FLEET/revealui" ] && [ ! -f "$FLEET/.jv/scripts/session-start-fleet.js" ]; then FLEET="$HOME/revealfleet"; fi; node "$FLEET/revealui/packages/harnesses/dist/cli.js" tmpscript check 2>/dev/null || revealui-harnesses tmpscript check 2>/dev/null || true
